messages:
nina.procure: Vendor Y sent the pilot invoice but quantities don't match the POC usage report. Invoice total looks inflated. tagging billing + finance.

harry.finance: drop both files here? i'll compare consumption vs invoice. quick flag: did vendor include 'setup' or 'one-time ingestion' fees we didn't expect?

kevin.ops: attaching the POC usage export from our side: we saw 2.1M events ingested, ~950GB stored ingested, retention 7 days. no one-time setup line was in our PO.

maya.billing: vendor invoice (snippet):
```
Invoice #7789 (Vendor Y)
- Ingest (GB): 1,200 @ $0.020 = $24.00
- Event processing (per 10k): 220 @ $6.00 = $1,320.00
- Onboarding fee: $3,500.00
- Pilot credit: -$2,000.00
Net due: $2,844.00
```
This doesn't line up with kevin's export. either their GB calc or event count is wrong.

nina.procure: we explicitly declined onboarding fees in the PO. Vendor's quote had it as optional. I asked them earlier to waive for pilot.

vendorbot: Vendor Y uploaded invoice PDF: https://vendory.example.com/invoice/7789 (pdf)

harry.finance: i compared our export to the vendor's line items. vendor's event processing shows 2.2M events (they rounded to 10k units -> 220 units) but our export shows 2.1M. 100k events delta = 10 units = $60. Not material. The bigger concern is the onboarding fee plus their ingest GB calc.

kevin.ops: their ingest GB number is 1,200GB but our S3 egress audit shows ~950GB transferred. Where are they getting the extra 250GB? Could be counting compressed vs uncompressed, or double-counting retransmits. We need their usage logs.

maya.billing: ask vendor to provide raw usage report (CSV) for the period, with the exact aggregation windows and unit definitions. Also ask for a sample invoice line-by-line mapping to their usage rows.

nina.procure: i've pinged our vendor rep asking for a CSV export and explanation of onboarding fee. Proposed message to vendor: "Please provide (1) raw usage CSV with timestamps, event counts, and byte counts; (2) mapping showing how usage rows roll up into billed units; (3) justification for any onboarding/set-up fees. We'll hold payment until we reconcile differences >$200." Thoughts?

harry.finance: ok to hold if within our normal payment terms, but flag: holding beyond due date may trigger late fees in their contract. Check contract for dispute process. If they billed onboarding in error we should request a corrected invoice immediately.

kevin.ops: also request the compression factor they used (if any). If vendor measures uncompressed bytes while we measure compressed, numbers will diverge. Include: "Please state whether ingest sizing is measured compressed or uncompressed, and whether they include metadata bytes or only payload."

vendorbot: Vendor Y replied: "We'll provide CSV and technical mapping by EOD. Onboarding fee was included because rep marked professional services. We can waive for pilot but require written amendment."

nina.procure: good. i'll request a corrected invoice that waives onboarding fee if they confirm in writing. Also insist they mark the pilot credit application on the corrected invoice clearly.

maya.billing: once we get their CSV, i'll do a line-by-line reconciliation and produce an AP memo. if vendor won't waive onboarding, escalate to legal for contract interpretation.

harry.finance: add a short payment plan: we release 80% of undisputed charges, withhold disputed remainder until reconciliation completes. that splits the difference and keeps vendor engaged.

kevin.ops: thumbs up to that. i'll help verify logs. also include a clause in future SOWs: usage definitions and measurement methodology must be included as an appendix to avoid this ambiguity.

nina.procure: agreed. i'll add that ask to our vendor template: "usage measurement spec + exported CSV capability + sample billing mapping."

vendorbot: Vendor Y submitted corrected invoice draft: https://vendory.example.com/invoice/7789/draft (v2)

maya.billing: will review the draft once the CSV lands. thanks everyone.

nina.procure: great work. i'll update the PO notes and set a 10-day SLA for vendor to deliver CSV and corrected invoice before we escalate.
